The '''Besh Gorgon system''', also known as '''The ''Wheel'' system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Maldrood sector/Legends|Maldrood sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], near [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]]. It had no natural planetary bodies. [[The Wheel/Legends|The ''Wheel'']] was located in the system.
